context: A boss reviews a corporate-ethics situation
purpose: Teach: 陣営/隠蔽/介助/接点/取り扱う/内臓/賛否/取り締まり

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、二陣営に分かれて、ロビー活動が活発だ。
lines.en: The industry's split into two camps right now—lobbying's heating up on both sides.
lines.style: Sharp, measured opening. Factual but carrying weight. Slight pause after the dash, letting the situation land. Steady eye contact—he's not alarmed, but alert.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。過去の隠蔽疑惑、再燃しないよう警戒しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're being careful to make sure those old suppression allegations don't resurface.
lines.style: Precise, methodical delivery. Each phrase lands with quiet intent. Respectful deference without hesitation—this is familiar territory for him now. Lean slightly forward on the commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: CSRで、介助関係の事業、接点を強化したい。
lines.en: Through CSR, I want to strengthen our connections in care-related operations.
lines.style: Crisp directive, almost conversational. Not commanding—collaborative intent. Slight emphasis on 'strengthen.' Pauses for acknowledgment, expecting engagement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 食品の内臓系部位の取り扱う規定、見直しています。
lines.en: We're currently reviewing the regulations on how we handle organ products in our food operations.
lines.style: Businesslike status report. No defensiveness, just factual pace. Professional tone that signals this is routine oversight, not crisis management.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の賛否、無視するな。当局の取り締まり、強まる可能性。
lines.en: Don't ignore what people in the industry are saying—on either side. Enforcement could tighten.
lines.style: Firm close, final word. Conviction on 'ignore' and 'tighten.' Not a threat—a recognition. Delivered with quiet authority, eyes steady. This is the reality he's outlining.
